format_instruction:
OUTPUT FORMAT OVERRIDE (field meanings and routing rules above still apply):
Return compact JSON with intent first and ONLY fields relevant to this intent that carry useful information. Omit nulls and default values (scope=one, phone_action=ring, missing_content=false, sound_theme=marimba). The application supplies defaults. Preserve nondefault timer sound themes and every meaningful slot. Never emit fields belonging to other intents.
For ask, omit query when the original user text is already the question; emit query only when needed to remove background speech or distinguish the actual question from a clarification. Examples: {"intent":"ask"}, {"intent":"timer_query"}, {"intent":"set_timer","duration_seconds":300}, {"intent":"timer_cancel","scope":"all"}. No prose or code fences.
